textual.potential_relevance: The stated recurring payout is directly linked to the requested purchase of a mining pool, creating a reward-and-payment relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the existence, performance or profitability of the pool, or any actual payout.

textual.observation: The tutorial links obtaining a 1000-day mining contract and activating the account to a one-time $99 enrollment fee and a Bitcoin Cash payment with a 10-minute transaction window.

visual.limitations: The frame does not show what happens after submission, whether the information is required for payment, or whether the earning claim was fulfilled.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes purchasing cloud-mining pools with promised payouts and specific mining-share prices and terms. It provides a participation and payment walkthrough involving a $99 enrollment fee and cryptocurrency transfer to a displayed Bitcoin Cash invoice within a 10-minute window. the available video evidence does not establish whether the service operated, payouts were made, or viewers experienced losses.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The walkthrough links purchasing mining-pool shares to stated recurring payouts based on the pool held. The separate membership enrollment payment is described as activating the account, not as a fee for earning guidance.
